# W3-B — MAX / Lottery-Effect Phase-0 (A-share AVOID-screen candidate)

*Generated by `scripts/china_max_phase0.py` · 1487 tickers from `data/china_stocks_raw`, 389 monthly rebalance dates, 1993-12-31 → 2026-04-30. Mean eligible names/rebalance: 882. Universe filter: board members with ≥756 rows history. Fill model: T+1 (high+low)/2 entry, locked-limit (hi==lo==close) bars excluded. Benchmark: CSI300 ETF proxy (510300.SS). MAX = max(daily return) over trailing 21 sessions (limit-up events INCLUDED — they are the lottery events).*

---

## Pre-registered verdict thresholds (fixed before run)

| verdict | condition |
|---|---|
| GO | L/S t_HAC ≥ 3 full-sample AND pre-2021 split t_HAC ≥ 2 (split-stable sign) |
| ACCRUE | 2 ≤ t_HAC < 3 full, OR era-only (2021+ only), OR sign-stable but \|t\|=2–3 |
| NO-GO | otherwise |

---

## 1. L/S spread (low-MAX D1 minus high-MAX D10) — fill-realistic and close-to-close

| era | n reb | mean excess/reb | HAC-t | hit | max DD |
|---|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| fill-real · full | 168 | -0.498% | -1.118 | 0.476 | -71.800% |
| fill-real · pre-2021 | 104 | -0.303% | -0.605 | 0.519 | -48.600% |
| fill-real · post-2021 | 64 | -0.814% | -0.982 | 0.406 | -63.000% |
| close-to-close · full | 168 | -0.764% | -1.635* | 0.488 | — |

**Rank-IC (MAX signal vs 21d CSI300-relative excess), full sample:**  mean IC = -0.046, t_HAC = -3.985, hit = 0.387, n = 168.
(Negative IC = higher MAX → lower forward excess; confirms lottery-effect DIRECTION.)

**Key divergence: IC is significant but L/S spread (t=-1.12) is not.**  The decile table reveals WHY: the relationship is NOT the classic monotone lottery decay (D1 outperforms, D10 underperforms). Instead it is **U-shaped** — D1 (low-MAX, near-stagnant names with max daily gain ~1-2%) earns LESS than D2–D7 (middle deciles, max daily gain 2-7%), while D10 (high-MAX, ~9-10% spike names) also underperforms the middle. Both tails underperform. The IC picks up the ranking relationship across all names (and it is real), but the actionable AVOID screen — excluding only D10 (high-MAX lottery names) — is not significant because D10 does not dramatically underperform the pool mean (D10 = 0.78% vs pool mean ≈ 0.90%). D1 (low-MAX) underperforms even more severely (0.28%). The published literature's D1-outperforms result does NOT replicate on this universe: stagnant/low-MAX names are NOT the low-risk alpha source here — they are likely illiquid / near-delisting names that also underperform.

---

## 2. Decile monotonicity (D1 = low-MAX, D10 = high-MAX)

| decile | D1 | D2 | D3 | D4 | D5 | D6 | D7 | D8 | D9 | D10 |
|---|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| mean excess/reb % | 0.279 | 0.824 | 0.807 | 1.170 | 1.104 | 1.103 | 1.157 | 1.035 | 0.787 | 0.777 |

Monotone steps (D_i > D_{i+1}): **6 / 9**  (9/9 = perfect; a clean lottery effect requires most steps to decrease from D1 to D10).

---

## 3. Screen test — does excluding top-MAX decile lift pool mean?

| | pool raw (all names) | pool ex-topMAX (D1-D9) | lift | t | p |
|---|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| mean excess/reb % | 0.904 | 0.919 | **0.015** | 0.520 | 0.606 |

The SCREEN-relevant statistic is whether excluding the top-MAX decile lifts the mean of the remaining pool. A positive lift with p < 0.10 supports using MAX as a defensive screen even if the full L/S spread is noisy.

---

## 4. 2000-permutation placebo (cross-sectional shuffle)

Real L/S t_HAC = **-1.108**  |  null: mean = -0.026, sd = 1.040, P(|t_null| ≥ 2) = 0.054  |  perm-p (real vs null) = **0.278**  (n_perm = 2000).

A valid null centers on 0 with sd ≈ 1. The real t sits WITHIN the null (perm-p = 0.278) — the L/S is statistically indistinguishable from random relabelling.

---

## 5. Positive control — within-sector reversal through the same harness

Within-sector reversal top-quintile (validated effect, phase0-verdicts #1):  mean excess = **0.374%/reb**, t_HAC = 2.333**, n = 168.

If the positive control fires (t ≥ 2), the harness is confirmed live — any MAX null is a true negative, not a dead instrument.

---

## 6. Orthogonality — MAX vs reversal and abnormal-turnover proxy

| factor | bivariate IC mean | bivariate t_HAC | partial IC vs y |\|rev,abn\| | partial t_HAC |
|---|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| MAX (signal under test) | -0.046 | -3.923*** | -0.037 | -3.200*** |
| Reversal (rev_z proxy) | 0.045 | 4.387*** | — | — |
| Abn-turn (vol-z proxy) | -0.017 | -2.468** | — | — |

Cross-sectional rank-correlation (MAX vs reversal): mean = -0.384  (near 0 = orthogonal; ±0.3+ = shared information).
Cross-sectional rank-correlation (MAX vs abn-turn): mean = 0.232.

Interpretation: if partial-IC-MAX collapses to near zero when reversal and abn-turn are controlled, MAX is redundant with its siblings and adds no independent defensive screen value.

---

## 7. Verdict

**NO-GO**

L/S t_HAC = -1.118 (full). The MAX / lottery-effect AVOID screen is NOT supported by this harness at this universe/period. Do not wire MAX as a defensive screen without re-running on a deeper panel.

**Supporting evidence:**
- L/S (low-MAX minus high-MAX) fill-realistic excess: -0.498%/reb (full), t_HAC = -1.118
- Pre-2021 split t_HAC = -0.605, post-2021 t_HAC = -0.982
- Rank-IC full: mean = -0.046, t_HAC = -3.985***
- Decile monotonicity: 6/9 decreasing steps
- Screen test lift: 0.015%/reb, t = 0.520, p = 0.606
- Permutation placebo perm-p = 0.278 (not significant)
- Positive control (reversal) t_HAC = 2.333 (instrument confirmed) — if ≥1.5, any MAX null is a true negative
- MAX vs reversal cross-corr = -0.384, MAX vs abn-turn cross-corr = 0.232

**Structural caveats (from measurement constitution):**
- Close-to-close overstates fill-realistic by ~0.9–1.1pp/entry; both are reported.
- Universe is board members only (1,487 tickers), not the full ~4,300 raw panel; this reduces survivorship bias vs `china_search` but does not eliminate it entirely.
- T+1 (H+L)/2 fill incurs a haircut vs the close; locked-limit bars are excluded.
- MAX is truncated by ±10% price limits in A-shares (per literature caution, §ashare-signal-research B); limit-up events are retained as the lottery events by design.
- Short history for newer names means the universe is different in early vs late periods; the pre/post-2021 split captures this regime/coverage change.
- DO NOT RE-RUN: volume dry-up, turn-confirmation, quiet-base, lianban continuation are falsified (do-not-rerun ledger); MAX is the ONLY new test here.

**Next step:** if verdict is GO or ACCRUE, wire MAX as a rank-DEMOTION chip on the board (not a standalone long signal). Register in registry_seed.json under program=china_alpha, wave=W3. Nothing is wired to any page/board/rank in this wave.
